title: 2023 Topps Composite - Topps Finest #188 Lynn Dickey Packers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Topps Composite trading card from the Topps Finest set featuring Lynn Dickey of the Green Bay Packers. This card is part of the base set, card number 188, and is manufactured by Topps for the National Football League (NFL) season. It is a sports trading card focusing on football, specifically the NFL, and is a collectible item for fans of the Green Bay Packers and Lynn Dickey.
